name: smj-jewellery-management-system
description: SMJ Jewellery Store Management System - retail billing, wholesale, inventory and reports

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
